name: logo-land
description: Develop brand-fit logos, deliberate color palettes and readable lettering with native Codex images, then compare, refine and export saved originals.

interface.shortDescription: Brand direction, color and lettering for product logos.
interface.longDescription: Connect your product and audience to a concrete logo direction, purposeful color roles and readable Korean or Latin lettering. Create a symbol, wordmark or symbol-and-name lockup on a clean canvas, with expressive styles when requested. Compare original PNGs and refine the chosen design while retaining its history. Export reviewed artwork with color evidence. Results are raster images; actual font files, vectors and platform icon layers are separate deliverables.
defaultPrompt: $logo-land Create a logo for my product. Use its audience and purpose to choose the shape, color roles and lettering.
$logo-land Create a clean symbol-and-name logo for Folio, an everyday notebook brand. Keep the exact text Folio on a plain white background.
$logo-land Create a calm, readable Korean wordmark for 모아, an adult reading app. Choose a coherent palette and use a plain white background.
$logo-land Create six independent IP character candidates for my reading app, using three directions.
$logo-land Create a playful LUMA wordmark with chunky multicolor lettering and no separate icon.
Keep #247A52 and suggest warmer companion colors for the selected logo.
Create a symbol-plus-text logo with the symbol above the exact brand name.
Create a transparent PNG logo and preserve intentional white lettering.
Resume my saved logo project and export the selected reviewed PNG.
